resources.string: Personal preview: detects foreground apps to block your selections. Reads labels in Android Settings, the system uninstaller and Play Store removal dialogs to recognize this app\'s own Accessibility and removal screens, then return you Home while protection is on. Other apps are excluded. Labels are not saved or sent. Pause protection inside Lockout Gate before changing its service or uninstalling.

Lockout Gate detects the foreground app to enforce your blocking choices and Keep Me Out.

This personal preview also reads labels inside Android Settings, the system uninstaller and Play Store removal dialogs. While protection is on, it returns you Home from its own Accessibility page, its own App info page with an Uninstall action, and recognized removal confirmations for this app. Wispr Flow and other apps are excluded. These labels are not saved or sent. It does not inspect screen contents in messaging or other apps.

Pause protection inside Lockout Gate before changing its Accessibility service or uninstalling. An active Keep Me Out lock must finish or be ended with the admin key first. This is on-device friction; it cannot guarantee protection against every removal method.

Your app list and habits stay on your phone. Keep Me Out sends a device identifier and lock requests to your configured server.

Personal preview: while protection is on, this app returns you Home from its own Accessibility, App info and recognized uninstall screens. It inspects labels locally in Android Settings, the system uninstaller and Play Store removal dialogs only. Other apps are excluded. Pause protection inside this app before changing its service or uninstalling; finish or administratively end Keep Me Out first if active. No Settings labels are saved or sent. This feature is excluded from the release intended for Google Play.
